items.title: Costco jumps into Medicare with limited time offering
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Business Reporter Brooke DiPalma joins Market Domination to discuss Costco’s (COST) plans to enter the Medicare market with limited, Costco-branded Medicare Advantage and supplemental plans through a partnership with nonprofit insurer SCAN Group. The rollout will initially target select states and could reach roughly 5 million Medicare enrollees.
